# Landometer Design System 0.9.7
Current version: 0.9.7. Color Set: color-srgb-10. Package: v0.9.7-owner.1 (owner-approved, unsigned).

- [Release downloads](https://github.com/montri-th/Landometer/releases/tag/v0.9.7)

Use exact bundled assets and current standalone rules. The complete handbook retains brand voice/visual foundations and identity/motif/motion scope. Story has 17 supporting values and 20 analytical families. Original LIGHT analytical HEX, anchors, LUT and classes are identical on both themes; preserve value direction. Do not derive, invert or recolor dark scales. Density remains warm. Existing categorical, identity and shared atmosphere assets retain their own theme rules.

The separate Location Intelligence Profile defines 16 roles, 12 quantitative recipes and 4 evidence-only SWOT lenses. Use it with the full LDS base, plus the product Add-on when applicable. Never treat a role accent as proof, eligibility or a measured score. Colours alone do not identify every metric uniquely; preserve labels, units, denominators, signs and meaningful zero.

For contrast use meaningful borders, readable labels or neutral backing surfaces without recolouring numerical data. Package validation is not universal accessibility/CVD certification. Local installation does not activate all accounts or the team. Explicit historical pins remain valid until migration.
- [Archived 0.9.6](https://montri-th.github.io/Landometer/v0.9.6/)
- [Archived 0.9.5](https://montri-th.github.io/Landometer/v0.9.5/)

Motion rules are included in the full base (§8.5–8.6). The package includes governed runtime and static SVGs; adding rules to Project Sources does not automatically animate output. Use final stills for static formats and reduced motion. ijji four-beat motifs remain static under Add-on 0.5.5; its finite logo sting is separate. Product overlays follow their current Add-on. Website build ui-20261002-lds097-r6 integrates Location in the main Atlas and makes 41 steps primary; complete existing 0.9.7 installations do not need replacement.
